title: Compton-Belkovich heat anomaly on the lunar far side
place_text: Compton-Belkovich, far side of the Moon

tellings.quote:
And NASA has found in imaging uh
infrared imaging of the
entire moon that there's this one area
that is emitting 20 times the average
heat output of the rest of the far side
of the moon.

plain: A researcher appearing as a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast says that NASA's infrared imaging of the whole Moon shows one area on the far side, a spot called Compton-Belkovich, giving off 20 times the average heat of the rest of the far side. The guest raises it as a mystery about the Moon that, if it holds up, would point to something unusual going on there.
